app_description:
Phase 1 hip extension feedback app using pelvis, right thigh, and left thigh IMU nodes. Feedback is only allowed when the right leg is in the target back-leg phase, the left thigh is forward, and the right hip is entering extension. Slow motions are handled with a trend window. v1.4.1 adds UDP orientation streaming diagnostics for a desktop 3D viewer.

Nodes Required: 4
-Sensing (3): pelvis (back center, switch pointing up), right_thigh (right lateral thigh, switch pointing up), left_thigh (left lateral thigh, switch pointing up)
-Feedback (1): feedback_min

parameters_setting.title: Enable Bilateral Phase Gate
parameters_setting.description: Only allow feedback when right leg is back and left thigh is forward

parameters_setting.title: Right Leg Back Threshold
parameters_setting.description: Threshold used to decide if the right thigh is in the target back-leg phase

parameters_setting.title: Right Leg Back Direction
parameters_setting.description: Direction for the right leg back phase threshold

parameters_setting.title: Left Thigh Forward Threshold
parameters_setting.description: Threshold used to decide if the left thigh is forward

parameters_setting.title: Left Thigh Forward Direction
parameters_setting.description: Direction for the left thigh forward threshold

parameters_setting.title: Enable Feedback
parameters_setting.description: Enable/Disable feedback

parameters_setting.title: Feedback Mode
parameters_setting.description: Signal used for threshold feedback

parameters_setting.title: Feedback Trigger Direction
parameters_setting.description: Use above for the current lateral thigh/back pelvis placement if normal extension is vibrating

parameters_setting.title: Feedback Threshold Angle
parameters_setting.description: Feedback threshold. Direction is controlled by Feedback Trigger Direction

parameters_setting.title: Hysteresis
parameters_setting.description: Deadband around threshold to prevent vibration chatter

parameters_setting.title: Cooldown Milliseconds
parameters_setting.description: Minimum time between repeated vibration pulses

parameters_setting.title: Moving Average Window
parameters_setting.description: Number of 100 Hz samples used to smooth hip angle

parameters_setting.title: Extension Direction
parameters_setting.description: How the right hip angle changes when the right hip is extending

parameters_setting.title: Extension Velocity Threshold
parameters_setting.description: Instant per-sample right hip angle change that starts extension detection

parameters_setting.title: Trend Window Milliseconds
parameters_setting.description: Time window used to detect slow sustained hip extension

parameters_setting.title: Extension Trend Threshold
parameters_setting.description: Angle change over the trend window needed to detect slow hip extension

parameters_setting.title: Reset Velocity Threshold
parameters_setting.description: Instant opposite-direction angle change that resets feedback during flexion

parameters_setting.title: Reset Trend Threshold
parameters_setting.description: Opposite-direction trend that resets feedback during slow flexion or sitting

parameters_setting.title: Enable Movement Gate
parameters_setting.description: Only allow vibration feedback while movement is detected

parameters_setting.title: Movement Gate Gyro Threshold
parameters_setting.description: Minimum thigh gyro magnitude required before feedback can vibrate

parameters_setting.title: Enable Orientation Debug
parameters_setting.description: Enable periodic IMU orientation debug output

parameters_setting.title: Print Orientation To Terminal
parameters_setting.description: Print yaw/pitch/roll and IMU X/Y/Z axes to the app terminal/log

parameters_setting.title: Stream Orientation Over UDP
parameters_setting.description: Send orientation JSON packets to the desktop 3D viewer

parameters_setting.title: Orientation Debug Hz
parameters_setting.description: How many orientation debug packets or print lines to emit per second

parameters_setting.title: UDP Port
parameters_setting.description: UDP destination port used by scripts/realtime_imu_orientation_viewer.py

parameters_setting.title: Save Mode
parameters_setting.description: Save file in specified format
